Title: Xul Patch
Subtitle: New hero: Xul Thrall's prices have been reduced to 7,000 and $8.49 USD.
Highlights: New hero: Xul Thrall's prices have been reduced to 7,000 and $8.49 USD.
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Brightwing's Phase Shift cooldown will no longer be reset after activating the Rewind Talent.

=== Heroes: Cho ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Gall will no longer be separated from Cho after manually exiting a Dragon Knight or Garden Terror.

=== Heroes: Gall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Gall will no longer be separated from Cho after manually exiting a Dragon Knight or Garden Terror.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Gazlowe's Rock-It! Turrets will now properly attack Doubloon Chests on Blackheart's Bay.

=== Heroes: Li-Ming ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Li-Ming's Critical Mass Trait will no longer trigger when one of The Lost Vikings is killed if she did not participate in the takedown.
  • Fixed a rare issue that could cause the effects of Li-Ming's Aether Walker Talent to become permanent under specific circumstances.
  • Fixed an issue that could cause Li-Ming's Magic Missiles to fire in erratic directions when cast immediately after exiting Archon form.

=== Heroes: Nova ===
[Updates]
  • Snipe (Q)
    • Damage increased from 295 (+4% per level) to 310 (+4% per level)
    • Snipe Master (Talent)
      • Damage bonus per stack increased from 12% to 15%. This effect can still stack up to 5 times
[Bug Fixes]
  • The effects of Nova's Explosive Round Talent will now be properly applied to Snipe after casting Rewind and Snipe in rapid succession.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Updates]
  • Lightning Shield (W)
    • Electric Charge (Talent)
      • Bonus to Lightning Shield radius decreased from 33% to 25%
    • Stormcaller (Talent)
      • No longer increases Lightning Shield duration
    • Earthshield (Talent)
      • Shield amount reduced from 15% to 12% of the target's maximum Health
  • Ancestral Healing (R)
    • Cooldown increased from 80 to 100 seconds
  • Bloodlust (R)
    • Mana cost reduced from 125 to 70
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Gladiator's War Shout Talent will no longer cause Rehgar's Bloodlust to affect Heroes outside its intended area of effect.

=== Heroes: The Lost Vikings ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Li-Ming's Critical Mass Trait will no longer trigger when one of The Lost Vikings is killed if she did not participate in the takedown.

=== Heroes: Tychus ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could cause Tychus to walk or stand while Mounted.

=== Heroes: Uther ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could cause Uther to become stuck in a death state if he was killed while the Redemption Talent's cooldown expired.

=== Heroes: Xul ===
[Releases]
  Xul, Cryptic Necromancer, has been added to the Nexus and is now available for play! Read on for a brief overview of his Abilities.:
  Trait:
  • Raise Skeleton
    • When a nearby enemy Minion dies, it becomes a Skeletal Warrior for 15 seconds. Up to 4 Skeletal Warriors can be active at once.
  Basic Abilities:
  • Bone Armor (1)
    • Activate to gain a Shield equal to 25% of your maximum Health for 3 seconds.
  • Spectral Scythe (Q)
    • Summon a scythe at target location that travels toward you after a 1 second delay, damaging enemies in its path.
  • Cursed Strikes (W)
    • Once activated, your Basic Attacks over the next 4 seconds deal damage in a wide arc and reduce the Attack Speed of enemies hit by 50% for 2 seconds.
  • Bone Prison (E)
    • After a 2 second delay, root target enemy in place for 2 seconds.
  Heroic Abilities:
  • Poison Nova (R)
    • After a short delay, release poisonous missiles that deal massive poison damage over 10 seconds to all enemies hit.
  • Skeletal Mages (R)
    • Summon 4 Skeletal Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies and slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Lasts up to 15 seconds.
